text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Disy party chief Yiannakis Matsis seeks the dismissal of all board members on the Cyprus electricity authority over tender irregularities.
- Turkish fighter jets violate Cyprus's aerospace during military exercise.
- Postal workers call off their overtime ban.
- Electricity authority chairman quits over a tenders row.
- Daily gatherings will be held at the Ledra Palace checkpoint to inform tourists on the Cyprus problem.
